mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate over three consecutive months indicates a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a reduction in consumer spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the same month indicates a strengthening demand side, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals deflationary pressure, which increases the real value of debt and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
